title: Runner price file
description: List prices a runner service publishes for the RelayRunner daily price check. See https://relayrunner.dev/docs/contribute/publish-prices

rate.description: The rate's id, as listed for your service under RATES in packages/providers/src/prices.ts.

per.description: What one minute of the rate is priced per.

usd_per_minute.description: The list price of one minute in US dollars, as a decimal string.

from.description: The UTC day the price starts. Leave it out for a price that applies now.
